# Market Map

Finviz's S&P 500 map, with the years running through it. Every tile is a
company; **area is market cap, color is the day's change**; tiles nest inside
GICS industries inside sectors, all real data — 461 constituents, every trading
day the baked file carries (the app reads its span, and its title, off the
data itself).

Two sprung scalars animate everything:

- **`day`** — a fractional index into the trading calendar. The slider drives
  it stiffly (direct but smooth); an era chip retargets it softly, so the map
  *flies* through the intervening years, market cap re-partitioning the whole
  canvas as it goes. Interrupt it anywhere.
- **`zoom`** — 0→1 onto one group. Click a sector or industry and its region
  lerps out to a stage over the dimmed map, every member laid out full-size
  with price, cap, trailing-year sparkline, and a hover/click probe. Inside a
  staged sector, clicking an industry **drills in place** — a third scalar
  blends the two stage layouts so arrivers grow from their sub-block while
  leavers shrink away.

The architecture is the example's real subject:

- `Market extends Node` — the **model as a faceless member**: it owns the
  DataSource, receives the payload in `onLoad`, and answers scalar queries as
  analyzed methods.
- `MarketLayout extends Layout` — the partition as a **live layout**: its
  `place()` reads `app.day` under tracking, so one evaluation per frame
  distributes every position. Sizes stay compiler-wired constraints on the
  classes — at 600 children, per-child size claims through `place()` are the
  seam's scaling cliff.
- `stageRoster` — a **derived Dataset** holding only the records the stage
  needs right now. Stage instances exist exactly while a stage key names
  them: nothing at boot, a dozen on open, reconciled by id on drill. Structure
  follows dependency, never a timer.
- The geometry engine and formatters live in the `script` block at the end of
  the file — pure functions, plus two *transparent* memo caches, which must be
  script state: a cache consulted during constraint evaluation has to stay
  invisible to dependency tracking.

## Market — the model

Owns the baked dataset (`marketmap-data.json`: per-stock closes, a share count
anchored to current caps, sector/industry) and the derived grouping tree. The
close series travel delta-coded — integer cents, first entry absolute, the
rest day-over-day changes (see `decodeCloses`) — and are decoded once here, so
the rest of the program only ever sees dollar prices. Data enters as state
through `onLoad` — the one place arrival must *cause* rather than merely be
derived from. Everything else is a pure query over that state.

segments.html:
class Market extends Node [

    stocks: object[] = [],
    days: string[] = [],
    industries: object[] = [],
    sectors: object[] = [],
    tree: object[] = [],                            // sector → industry → rows, built once
    nDays: number = 0,
    ready: boolean = false,

    // beside this program on its own page; beside its home when a host (the
    // desktop) mounts it as an island and provides that home as `base`

    src: DataSource [ url = { hostProvided("base", "") + "marketmap-data.json" }, auto = true,
        onLoad() {
            const v = this.value as { days: string[], stocks: Stock[],
                industries: object[], sectors: object[] }
            const stocks = v.stocks.map(s => ({ ...s, closes: decodeCloses(s.closes) }))
            classroot.days = v.days
            classroot.stocks = stocks as unknown as object[]
            classroot.industries = v.industries
            classroot.sectors = v.sectors
            classroot.tree = buildTree(stocks) as unknown as object[]
            classroot.nDays = v.days.length
            classroot.ready = true
            classroot.landed(v.days.length)
            }
        ],

    // the decoded table the view replicates from. Consumers never touch
    // `src.value` — that is the wire payload, closes still delta-coded.

    tableValue() -> object {
        return { stocks: this.stocks, industries: this.industries, sectors: this.sectors }
        },
    table: Dataset [ contents = { classroot.tableValue() } ],

    // arrival seam: called once, with the day count, when the payload is in
    // place. Empty here — the App's instance overrides it to open on the
    // data's last day outright (an arrival is a fact, not a change the map
    // lived through, so it must not fly there).

    landed(nDays: number) { },

    // ── scalar queries, all over a fractional day index ──

    priceAt(closes: number[], day: number) -> number { return interpClose(closes, day) },

    capAt(shares: number, closes: number[], day: number) -> number {
        return shares * interpClose(closes, day)
        },

    // the day-over-day return, interpolated between adjacent trading days

    dayChangeAt(closes: number[], day: number) -> number {
        const n = closes.length
        const i = Math.floor(day)
        const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, day - i))
        const k1 = Math.max(1, Math.min(n - 1, i))
        const k2 = Math.max(1, Math.min(n - 1, i + 1))
        const r1 = (closes[k1 - 1] > 0 && closes[k1] > 0) ? closes[k1] / closes[k1 - 1] - 1 : 0
        const r2 = (closes[k2 - 1] > 0 && closes[k2] > 0) ? closes[k2] / closes[k2 - 1] - 1 : 0
        return r1 + (r2 - r1) * t
        },

    returnOver(closes: number[], day: number, span: number) -> number {
        const now = interpClose(closes, day)
        const then = interpClose(closes, day - span)
        return (now > 0 && then > 0) ? now / then - 1 : 0
        },

    // nearest trading day at or after an ISO date; past the end = the last day,
    // which is what lets the LAST DAY chip use a far-future date

    dayIndexOf(iso: string) -> number {
        const ds = this.days as string[]
        if (ds.length == 0) return 0
        for (let i = 0; i < ds.length; i++) if (ds[i] >= iso) return i
        return ds.length - 1
        },

    dateAt(day: number) -> string {
        const ds = this.days as string[]
        if (ds.length == 0) return ""
        return ds[Math.max(0, Math.min(ds.length - 1, Math.round(day)))]
        },

    // the staged group's aggregate, for the stage header

    groupStat(groupKey: string, day: number) -> string {
        if (groupKey == "") return ""
        const sector = groupKey.slice(0, 4) == "sec:" ? groupKey.slice(4) : ""
        const parts = groupKey.split("|")
        if (sector == "" && parts.length < 2) return ""
        let cap = 0
        let capPrev = 0
        for (const s of this.stocks as Stock[]) {
            if (sector != "" ? s.sector != sector : (s.sector != parts[0] || s.industry != parts[1])) continue
            cap += s.shares * interpClose(s.closes, day)
            capPrev += s.shares * interpClose(s.closes, day - 1)
            }
        return fmtCap(cap) + "  ·  " + fmtPct(capPrev > 0 ? cap / capPrev - 1 : 0) + " TODAY"
        },

    // the sparkline probe's readout: date · price · cap at fraction `u` of the
    // trailing year

    probeLine(closes: number[], shares: number, day: number, u: number) -> string {
        if (u < 0) return ""
        const f = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.nDays - 1, day - TRADING_YEAR + TRADING_YEAR * u))
        const iso = this.dateAt(f)
        const price = interpClose(closes, f)
        if (price <= 0) return fmtDateShort(iso) + "  ·  NOT YET LISTED"
        return fmtDateShort(iso) + "  ·  " + fmtPrice(price) + "  ·  " + fmtCap(shares * price)
        },

    // which records does the stage need right now? The current group, plus the
    // departing one while a drill morph is in flight. `stageRoster` derives
    // from this, and the stage replications feed from the roster — so stage
    // instances exist exactly when a stage key names them. Rows carry an `id`
    // so reconciliation keeps instance identity across drills.

    rosterFor(current: string, previous: string) -> object {
        const rows = [] as object[]
        const bands = [] as object[]
        if (current == "" || !this.ready) return { rows, bands }
        for (const s of this.stocks as Stock[]) {
            const k = s.sector + "|" + s.industry
            if (k == current || k == previous
                || current == "sec:" + s.sector || previous == "sec:" + s.sector)
                rows.push({ id: s.sym, sym: s.sym, name: s.name, sector: s.sector,
                    industry: s.industry, shares: s.shares, closes: s.closes })
            }
        const inds = this.industries as { id: string, sector: string, label: string }[]
        for (const i of inds) {
            if (current == "sec:" + i.sector || previous == "sec:" + i.sector) bands.push(i)
            }
        return { rows, bands }
        }
    ]

## The layouts

A base `Layout`'s place-pass is a live tracked constraint, so a `place()` that
reads `app.day` re-places continuously — the whole map morphs against the
scrub with one evaluation distributing every position.

The boxes carry `x`/`y` only, deliberately: a box that also carried `w`/`h`
would install a separate runtime constraint per child per dimension, each
re-evaluating `place()` — measured at 600 children, that alone drops a
five-year flight from 45 fps to 1.4. Sizes stay compiler-wired constraints on
the classes instead: positions through the pass, sizes through static edges.

segments.html:
class MarketLayout extends Layout [
    place() {
        const holder = parent as View
        const lay = mapPartition(app.market.stocks as Stock[], app.market.tree as SecNode[],
            app.day, holder.width, holder.height)
        return this.laid().map((c) => {
            const r = lay[(c as Tile).pid]
            // x/y only — a box's shape declares ownership, and sizes belong
            // to the classes' own wired constraints
            return r ? { x: r.x, y: r.y } : { x: OFFSTAGE.x, y: OFFSTAGE.y }
            })
        }
    ]


class StageLayout extends Layout [
    place() {
        const holder = parent as View
        const lay = stagePartition(app.market.stocks as Stock[], app.market.tree as SecNode[],
            app.day, holder.width, holder.height,
            app.stageKey, app.zoom, app.prevStageKey, app.drillProgress)
        return this.laid().map((c) => {
            const p = (c as StageTile).pid
            const r = lay["stage:" + p] ?? lay[p]
            return r ? { x: r.x, y: r.y } : { x: OFFSTAGE.x, y: OFFSTAGE.y }
            })
        }
    ]

## Tile

One company on the map. The layout owns its position; its size and color are
wired constraints over the same partition (a memo-hit — see the script block).
Symbol, then the company name and the day's change when the tile is roomy
enough — the name gates on its own measured width, so it appears exactly when
it fits.

segments.html:
class Tile extends View [ cursor = "pointer",

    pid: string = { :sym },
    slot: object = { rectFor(mapPartition(app.market.stocks as Stock[], app.market.tree as SecNode[], app.day, app.mapW, app.mapH) as Record<string, Rect>, :sym) },
    dayChange: number = { app.market.dayChangeAt(:closes as number[], app.day) },
    groupKey: string = { (:sector as string) + "|" + (:industry as string) },
    roomy: boolean = { this.width >= 120 && this.height >= 86 },

    width = { (this.slot as Rect).w },
    height = { (this.slot as Rect).h },
    fill = { changeColor(this.dayChange) },

    onPointerOver() { app.spot(:sym)
        app.hotGroup = this.groupKey },
    onClick() { app.openGroup(this.groupKey) },

    sym: Text [ x = center,
        y = { (classroot.height - this.height) / 2 - (classroot.roomy ? 12 : 0) },
        fontWeight = bold, textColor = { provided("theme").ink },
        fontSize = { Math.max(8, Math.min(22, Math.round(classroot.width / 5))) },
        visible = { classroot.width > 26 && classroot.height > 16 },
        text = :sym ],
    companyName: Text [ x = center, y = { classroot.height / 2 + 6 }, fontSize = 9,
        letterSpacing = 1, textColor = { provided("theme").ink }, opacity = 0.6,
        visible = { classroot.roomy && this.width < classroot.width - 10 },
        text = { ((:name as string) || "").toUpperCase() } ],
    pct: Text [ x = center,
        y = { classroot.height / 2 + (classroot.roomy ? 24 : 13) },
        fontSize = 9, textColor = { provided("theme").inkSoft }, opacity = 0.85,
        visible = { classroot.width > 58 && classroot.height > 48 },
        text = { fmtPct(classroot.dayChange) } ]
    ]

## SectorBand · IndustryBand

The group labels are the map's interaction surface for whole groups: hover
haloes the group (label goes finviz-yellow with dark ink), click opens it on
the stage. Both write the one `app.hotGroup` key; the halo view derives its
rectangle from it. Highlights are *gated* on `app.fieldHover` rather than
cleared by pointer-out events — when the pointer leaves the grid, the derived
gate drops and every highlight follows.

segments.html:
class SectorBand extends View [ cursor = "pointer", clip = true,

    pid: string = { "sector:" + (:id as string) },
    hot: boolean = { app.hotGroup == "sec:" + (:id as string) && app.zoom < 0.05 && app.fieldHover },

    height = { SECTOR_BAND_H },
    width = { rectFor(mapPartition(app.market.stocks as Stock[], app.market.tree as SecNode[], app.day, app.mapW, app.mapH) as Record<string, Rect>, this.pid).w },
    fill = { this.hot ? provided("theme").highlight : provided("theme").sectorBand },

    onPointerOver() { app.hotGroup = "sec:" + (:id as string) },
    onClick() { app.openGroup("sec:" + (:id as string)) },

    Text [ x = 7, y = center, fontSize = 9, letterSpacing = 2, fontWeight = bold,
        textColor = { classroot.hot ? provided("theme").inkOnHighlight : provided("theme").bandInk }, text = :label ]
    ]


class IndustryBand extends View [ cursor = "pointer", clip = true,

    pid: string = { "ind:" + (:id as string) },
    hot: boolean = { app.hotGroup == (:id as string) && app.zoom < 0.05 && app.fieldHover },

    height = { INDUSTRY_BAND_H },
    width = { rectFor(mapPartition(app.market.stocks as Stock[], app.market.tree as SecNode[], app.day, app.mapW, app.mapH) as Record<string, Rect>, this.pid).w },
    fill = { this.hot ? provided("theme").highlight : provided("theme").industryBand },

    onPointerOver() { app.hotGroup = (:id) },
    onClick() { app.openGroup(:id) },

    Text [ x = 6, y = center, fontSize = 8, letterSpacing = 1,
        textColor = { classroot.hot ? provided("theme").inkOnHighlight : provided("theme").industryInk }, text = :label ]
    ]

## StageTile

A company on the stage — the full card: symbol, name, day change, price · cap ·
trailing-year return, and a sparkline of the trailing year drawn along the
tile's floor (a `draw()` mark, not a field: only the staged dozen ever record
anything). The card degrades tier by tier as tiles shrink.

The sparkline takes a probe: hovering scrubs it (derived from the built-in
`hovered` and `app.pointerX` — no handler), and in an industry stage a click
pins it. In a *sector* stage a click drills into the tile's industry instead —
the pin belongs where there is nothing left to open.

Staged tiles replicate from the roster, so every instance here is on stage (or
departing mid-drill — `mine` keeps the leavers laid until the morph lands).

segments.html:
class StageTile extends View [ cursor = "pointer", clip = true,
    x = -900, y = -900,                             // parked until the layout places it

    pid: string = { :sym },
    groupKey: string = { (:sector as string) + "|" + (:industry as string) },
    mine: boolean = { this.groupKey == app.stageKey
        || app.stageKey == "sec:" + (:sector as string)
        || (app.drillProgress < 0.98
            && (this.groupKey == app.prevStageKey
                || app.prevStageKey == "sec:" + (:sector as string))) },
    ignoreLayout = { !this.mine },

    stageSlot: object = { this.mine && app.zoom > 0.002
        ? rectFor(stagePartition(app.market.stocks as Stock[], app.market.tree as SecNode[], app.day, app.mapW, app.mapH, app.stageKey, app.zoom, app.prevStageKey, app.drillProgress) as Record<string, Rect>, "stage:" + (:sym as string))
        : rectFor(null as unknown as Record<string, Rect>, "") },
    dayChange: number = { this.mine ? app.market.dayChangeAt(:closes as number[], app.day) : 0 },
    yearReturn: number = { this.mine ? app.market.returnOver(:closes as number[], app.day, TRADING_YEAR) : 0 },
    big: boolean = { this.width > 150 && this.height > 116 },
    tall: boolean = { this.height >= 148 },

    width = { Math.max(0, (this.stageSlot as Rect).w) },
    height = { Math.max(0, (this.stageSlot as Rect).h) },
    visible = { this.mine && app.zoom > 0.002 && this.x > -800 },
    fill = { changeColor(this.dayChange) },

    // the probe: hover scrubs the trailing year; a click (or tap) pins it

    hoverU: number = { this.mine && this.big && this.hovered
        ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (app.pointerX - this.x - 10) / Math.max(1, this.width - 20)))
        : -1 },
    pinnedU: number = -1,
    probeU: number = { this.hovered && this.hoverU >= 0 ? this.hoverU : this.pinnedU },

    onPointerOver() { app.spot(:sym)
        if (app.stageKey.slice(0, 4) == "sec:") app.hotStaged = this.groupKey },
    onClick(e: PointerEvent) {
        if (app.stageKey.slice(0, 4) == "sec:") { app.drill(this.groupKey); return }
        if (this.big) pinnedU = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (e.x - 10) / Math.max(1, this.width - 20))) },

    // the trailing year, inscribed along the tile's floor; gold marks the probe

    draw(d: Draw) {
        if (!this.mine || !this.big || app.zoom < 0.4) return
        const closes = :closes as number[]
        const day = app.day
        const w = this.width
        const h = this.height
        const top = h * SPARK_TOP
        const span = h * SPARK_SPAN
        const N = 56
        let lo = 1e18
        let hi = -1e18
        const pts = [] as number[]
        for (let k = 0; k <= N; k++) {
            const v = interpClose(closes, day - TRADING_YEAR + (TRADING_YEAR * k) / N)
            pts.push(v)
            if (v > 0) { if (v < lo) lo = v; if (v > hi) hi = v }
        }
        if (hi <= lo) return
        const ink = provided("theme").ink
        d.strokeStyle = colorWithAlpha(ink, 71)
        d.lineWidth = 1
        d.beginPath()
        d.moveTo(10, top + span)
        d.lineTo(w - 10, top + span)
        d.stroke()
        d.strokeStyle = colorWithAlpha(ink, 191)
        d.lineWidth = 1.6
        d.lineJoin = "round"
        d.beginPath()
        for (let k = 0; k <= N; k++) {
            const px = 10 + ((w - 20) * k) / N
            const py = pts[k] > 0 ? top + span - ((pts[k] - lo) / (hi - lo)) * span : top + span
            if (k == 0) d.moveTo(px, py)
            else d.lineTo(px, py)
        }
        d.stroke()
        d.fillStyle = ink
        d.beginPath()
        d.arc(w - 10, top + span - ((pts[N] - lo) / (hi - lo)) * span, 2.4, 0, Math.PI * 2)
        d.fill()
        const u = this.probeU
        if (u >= 0) {
            const px = 10 + (w - 20) * u
            const v = interpClose(closes, day - TRADING_YEAR + TRADING_YEAR * u)
            d.strokeStyle = colorWithAlpha(provided("theme").highlight, 140)
            d.lineWidth = 1
            d.beginPath()
            d.moveTo(px, h * 0.62)
            d.lineTo(px, top + span)
            d.stroke()
            if (v > 0) {
                d.fillStyle = provided("theme").highlight
                d.beginPath()
                d.arc(px, top + span - ((v - lo) / (hi - lo)) * span, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2)
                d.fill()
            }
        }
        },

    sym: Text [ x = center,
        y = { classroot.big ? classroot.height * 0.18 : (classroot.height - this.height) / 2 },
        fontWeight = bold, textColor = { provided("theme").ink },
        fontSize = { Math.max(8, Math.min(30, Math.round(classroot.width / 5))) },
        visible = { classroot.width > 20 && classroot.height > 14 },
        text = { classroot.mine ? (:sym as string) : "" } ],
    companyName: Text [ x = center, y = { classroot.height * 0.18 + 36 }, fontSize = 10,
        letterSpacing = 1, textColor = { provided("theme").ink }, opacity = 0.7,
        visible = { classroot.big && classroot.tall && this.width < classroot.width - 12 },
        text = { classroot.mine ? ((:name as string) || "").toUpperCase() : "" } ],
    pct: Text [ x = center,
        y = { classroot.big
            ? classroot.height * 0.18 + (classroot.tall ? 56 : 34)
            : classroot.height / 2 + 15 },
        fontSize = { classroot.big ? 12 : 10 }, textColor = { provided("theme").inkSoft }, opacity = 0.9,
        visible = { classroot.width > 48 && classroot.height > 44 },
        text = { classroot.mine ? fmtPct(classroot.dayChange) + (classroot.big ? " TODAY" : "") : "" } ],
    statLine: Text [ x = center,
        y = { classroot.height * 0.18 + (classroot.tall ? 76 : 54) }, fontSize = 10,
        textColor = { provided("theme").inkSoft }, opacity = 0.75,
        visible = { classroot.big && classroot.height >= 180 },
        text = { classroot.mine && classroot.big
            ? fmtPrice(app.market.priceAt(:closes as number[], app.day)) + "  ·  "
                + fmtCap(app.market.capAt(:shares as number, :closes as number[], app.day))
                + "  ·  1Y " + fmtPct(classroot.yearReturn)
            : "" } ],

    probeChip: View [ fill = { provided("theme").probeChip }, cornerRadius = 4, height = 18, opacity = 0.94,
        pointerEvents = "none",
        visible = { classroot.probeU >= 0 && classroot.big && app.zoom > 0.5 },
        width = { this.t.width + 14 },
        x = { Math.max(4, Math.min(classroot.width - this.width - 4,
            10 + (classroot.width - 20) * Math.max(0, classroot.probeU) - this.width / 2)) },
        y = { classroot.height * SPARK_TOP - 26 },
        t: TextLabel [ x = 7, fontSize = 9, letterSpacing = 1, textColor = { provided("theme").highlight },
            text = { classroot.probeU >= 0
                ? app.market.probeLine(:closes as number[], :shares as number, app.day, classroot.probeU)
                : "" } ]
        ]
    ]

## StageBand

An industry's label strip inside a staged sector — the drill target. Same
yellow treatment as the map bands, driven by the same `hotStaged` key the
staged tiles write, gated on the popup being under the pointer.

segments.html:
class StageBand extends View [ cursor = "pointer", clip = true,
    x = -900, y = -900,                             // parked until the layout places it

    pid: string = { "stgband:" + (:id as string) },
    mine: boolean = { app.stageKey == "sec:" + (:sector as string)
        || (app.drillProgress < 0.98 && app.prevStageKey == "sec:" + (:sector as string)) },
    ignoreLayout = { !this.mine },
    hot: boolean = { this.mine && (this.hovered || (app.stageHover && app.hotStaged == (:id as string))) },

    bandSlot: object = { this.mine && app.zoom > 0.002
        ? rectFor(stagePartition(app.market.stocks as Stock[], app.market.tree as SecNode[], app.day, app.mapW, app.mapH, app.stageKey, app.zoom, app.prevStageKey, app.drillProgress) as Record<string, Rect>, this.pid)
        : rectFor(null as unknown as Record<string, Rect>, "") },
    width = { Math.max(0, (this.bandSlot as Rect).w) },
    height = { Math.max(0, (this.bandSlot as Rect).h) },
    visible = { this.mine && app.zoom > 0.002 && this.x > -800 },
    fill = { this.hot ? provided("theme").highlight : provided("theme").industryBand },

    onPointerOver() { app.hotStaged = (:id) },
    onClick() { app.drill(:id) },

    Text [ x = 6, y = center, fontSize = 9, letterSpacing = 1,
        textColor = { classroot.hot ? provided("theme").inkOnHighlight : provided("theme").bandInk },
        text = { classroot.mine ? (:label as string) : "" } ]
    ]

## EraChip · LegendSwatch

Console furniture. A chip flies the map to a date (nearest trading day — LAST
DAY simply names a far-future date); a swatch shows the color scale.

segments.html:
class EraChip extends View [ height = 20, cornerRadius = 10, cursor = "pointer",
    label: string = "",
    iso: string = "",
    fill = { hovered ? provided("theme").chipHover : provided("theme").chip },
    width = { this.t.width + 18 },
    onClick() { app.flyTo(this.iso) },
    t: TextLabel [ x = 9, fontSize = 9, letterSpacing = 1.5, textColor = { provided("theme").chipInk },
        text = { label } ]
    ]


class LegendSwatch extends View [ height = 18, cornerRadius = 2,
    pct: number = 0,
    width = { app.narrow ? 40 : 52 },
    fill = { changeColor(this.pct / 100) },
    Text [ x = center, y = center, fontSize = 9, fontWeight = bold, textColor = { provided("theme").ink },
        text = { (pct > 0 ? "+" : "") + pct + "%" } ]
    ]

## The geometry engine

Pure functions — the treemap partition, the stage layouts, color and text
formatting. Two of them keep a one-entry memo, and that memo is *deliberately*
script state: within a settle every reader asks for the same partition
(computed defaults inline per reader), so something must materialize it — and
a cache consulted during constraint evaluation must be invisible to dependency
tracking. Held in node attributes its reads would subscribe every consumer and
its writes would invalidate them: a self-defeating broadcast, divergent the
moment two keys are alive in one settle. Transparent caches (same inputs, same
output, always) are exactly the state the script rule permits.

segments.html:
script {
    type Stock = { sym: string, name: string, sector: string, industry: string, shares: number, closes: number[] }
    type Rect = { x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number }
    type IndNode = { name: string, key: string, rows: Stock[], syms: string[] }
    type SecNode = { name: string, inds: IndNode[] }

    // ── shared constants ──

    const TRADING_YEAR = 250            // trading days in the sparkline / 1Y window
    const SECTOR_BAND_H = 18
    const INDUSTRY_BAND_H = 13
    const STAGE_BAND_H = 15
    const STAGE_HEAD_H = 30
    const EDGE_GUTTER = 3               // room for the halo stroke at the map's edges
    const TILE_GAP = 1                  // the dark grid line between tiles
    const MIN_TILE_PX = 2.5             // below this, a tile parks offscreen
    const OFFSTAGE: Rect = { x: -900, y: -900, w: 0, h: 0 }
    const SPARK_TOP = 0.70              // the sparkline band, as fractions of tile height
    const SPARK_SPAN = 0.24

    // ── small geometry helpers ──

    function rounded(r: Rect): Rect {
        return { x: Math.round(r.x), y: Math.round(r.y), w: Math.round(r.w), h: Math.round(r.h) }
    }

    function lerpRect(a: Rect, b: Rect, t: number): Rect {
        return { x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, y: a.y + (b.y - a.y) * t,
            w: a.w + (b.w - a.w) * t, h: a.h + (b.h - a.h) * t }
    }

    function shrunk(r: Rect): Rect {
        return { x: r.x + r.w / 2, y: r.y + r.h / 2, w: 0, h: 0 }
    }

    // null-guarded lookup: a just-created instance can read its datapath as
    // null for a beat, and a missing key must never throw mid-layout
    function rectFor(lay: Record<string, Rect>, id: string): Rect {
        return (lay && id && lay[id]) ? lay[id] : { x: -900, y: -900, w: 40, h: 30 }
    }

    // The file stores each close series delta-coded: first entry is the price
    // in integer cents, every later entry the change from the day before.
    // Daily moves are small integers, so the file is ~40% smaller raw and a
    // third smaller compressed than absolute prices — losslessly. One running
    // sum here turns it back into ordinary dollar floats; everything past
    // onLoad sees absolute prices and knows nothing of the encoding.
    function decodeCloses(deltas: number[]): number[] {
        let cents = 0
        return deltas.map(d => (cents += d) / 100)
    }

    // the close price at a fractional day — linear between adjacent sessions
    function interpClose(closes: number[], day: number): number {
        if (!closes || closes.length == 0) return 0
        const n = closes.length
        const i = Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, Math.floor(day)))
        const j = Math.min(n - 1, i + 1)
        const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, day - i))
        return closes[i] + (closes[j] - closes[i]) * t
    }

    // ── the balanced bisection ──
    // Split the id list into two weight-halves, split the rectangle along its
    // long axis in the same ratio, recurse: treemap nesting at every scale,
    // order adjacency preserved, area proportional to weight.

    function bisect(out: Record<string, Rect>, ids: string[], ws: number[],
        x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number): void {
        if (ids.length == 0) return
        if (ids.length == 1) { out[ids[0]] = { x, y, w, h }; return }
        const total = ws.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
        let acc = 0
        let cut = 1
        for (let i = 0; i < ids.length - 1; i++) {
            acc += ws[i]
            if (acc >= total / 2) { cut = i + 1; break }
            cut = i + 2
        }
        cut = Math.max(1, Math.min(ids.length - 1, cut))
        const frac = total > 0 ? ws.slice(0, cut).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / total : 0.5
        if (w >= h) {
            bisect(out, ids.slice(0, cut), ws.slice(0, cut), x, y, w * frac, h)
            bisect(out, ids.slice(cut), ws.slice(cut), x + w * frac, y, w * (1 - frac), h)
        } else {
            bisect(out, ids.slice(0, cut), ws.slice(0, cut), x, y, w, h * frac)
            bisect(out, ids.slice(cut), ws.slice(cut), x, y + h * frac, w, h * (1 - frac))
        }
    }

    // ── the grouping tree ──
    // Built once per dataset from Market.onLoad. Orderings sort by
    // end-of-window cap, so the frame order never changes as the day scrubs —
    // only areas move.

    function buildTree(stocks: Stock[]): SecNode[] {
        const last = stocks[0].closes.length - 1
        const capEnd: Record<string, number> = {}
        for (const s of stocks) capEnd[s.sym] = s.shares * interpClose(s.closes, last)
        const secs = [] as string[]
        for (const s of stocks) if (!secs.includes(s.sector)) secs.push(s.sector)
        const tree = secs.map(sec => {
            const inSec = stocks.filter(s => s.sector == sec)
            const inds = [] as string[]
            for (const s of inSec) if (!inds.includes(s.industry)) inds.push(s.industry)
            const nodes = inds.map(ind => {
                const rows = inSec.filter(s => s.industry == ind)
                    .sort((a, b) => capEnd[b.sym] - capEnd[a.sym])
                return { name: ind, key: sec + "|" + ind, rows, syms: rows.map(s => s.sym) }
            })
            nodes.sort((a, b) => b.rows.reduce((x, s) => x + capEnd[s.sym], 0)
                - a.rows.reduce((x, s) => x + capEnd[s.sym], 0))
            return { name: sec, inds: nodes }
        })
        tree.sort((a, b) =>
            b.inds.reduce((x, i) => x + i.rows.reduce((y, s) => y + capEnd[s.sym], 0), 0)
            - a.inds.reduce((x, i) => x + i.rows.reduce((y, s) => y + capEnd[s.sym], 0), 0))
        return tree
    }

    // ── the map partition ──
    // sector strips → industry blocks → tiles, keyed "sector:X" / "ind:K" /
    // "zone:K" (an industry's full block, for the halo) / plain symbol.
    // Integer rects mean a slow-moving tile yields identical values frame
    // over frame, and equal writes settle out; sub-pixel slivers share one
    // parked rect for the same reason.

    let mapMemoKey = ""
    let mapMemoVal: Record<string, Rect> = {}
    function mapPartition(stocks: Stock[], tree: SecNode[], day: number,
        W: number, H: number): Record<string, Rect> {
        if (!stocks || stocks.length == 0 || !tree || tree.length == 0 || !W || !H) return {}
        const memoKey = day.toFixed(4) + "|" + W + "|" + H + "|" + stocks.length
        if (memoKey == mapMemoKey) return mapMemoVal
        const out: Record<string, Rect> = {}
        const capNow: Record<string, number> = {}
        for (const s of stocks) capNow[s.sym] = s.shares * interpClose(s.closes, day)
        const indWeight = (i: IndNode) => i.rows.reduce((a, s) => a + capNow[s.sym], 0)
        const sectorBoxes: Record<string, Rect> = {}
        bisect(sectorBoxes, tree.map(t => t.name),
            tree.map(t => t.inds.reduce((a, i) => a + indWeight(i), 0)),
            EDGE_GUTTER, 0, W - 2 * EDGE_GUTTER, H)
        for (const t of tree) {
            const sb = sectorBoxes[t.name]
            out["sector:" + t.name] = rounded(sb)
            const indBoxes: Record<string, Rect> = {}
            bisect(indBoxes, t.inds.map(i => i.key), t.inds.map(indWeight),
                sb.x, sb.y + SECTOR_BAND_H, sb.w, Math.max(6, sb.h - SECTOR_BAND_H))
            for (const i of t.inds) {
                const ib = indBoxes[i.key]
                out["zone:" + i.key] = rounded(ib)
                const bandH = (ib.h >= 46 && ib.w >= 70) ? INDUSTRY_BAND_H : 0
                if (bandH > 0) out["ind:" + i.key] = rounded({ x: ib.x, y: ib.y, w: ib.w, h: bandH })
                bisect(out, i.syms, i.rows.map(s => capNow[s.sym]),
                    ib.x, ib.y + bandH, ib.w, Math.max(2, ib.h - bandH))
                for (const sym of i.syms) {
                    const r = out[sym]
                    out[sym] = (r.w < MIN_TILE_PX || r.h < MIN_TILE_PX) ? OFFSTAGE
                        : rounded({ x: r.x, y: r.y,
                            w: Math.max(0, r.w - TILE_GAP), h: Math.max(0, r.h - TILE_GAP) })
                }
            }
        }
        mapMemoKey = memoKey
        mapMemoVal = out
        return out
    }

    // ── the stage partition ──
    // The staged group's zone lerps from its map position to center court by
    // `zoom`; its members lay out inside ("stage:SYM", plus "stgband:"/
    // "stgzone:" sub-strips when a whole sector is staged). During a drill,
    // the previous and next rosters are laid in the same stage box and
    // blended by `progress` — arrivers grow from their sub-block, leavers
    // shrink to their own centers.

    function stageEntries(tree: SecNode[], day: number, key: string, z: Rect): Record<string, Rect> {
        const out: Record<string, Rect> = {}
        const inner = (extra: number) => Math.max(6, z.h - STAGE_HEAD_H - 4 - extra)
        if (key.slice(0, 4) == "sec:") {
            const sec = key.slice(4)
            for (const t of tree) if (t.name == sec) {
                const capNow: Record<string, number> = {}
                for (const i of t.inds) for (const s of i.rows)
                    capNow[s.sym] = s.shares * interpClose(s.closes, day)
                const indBoxes: Record<string, Rect> = {}
                bisect(indBoxes, t.inds.map(i => i.key),
                    t.inds.map(i => i.rows.reduce((a, s) => a + capNow[s.sym], 0)),
                    z.x + 3, z.y + STAGE_HEAD_H + 1, Math.max(8, z.w - 6), inner(0))
                for (const i of t.inds) {
                    const ib = indBoxes[i.key]
                    out["stgzone:" + i.key] = rounded(ib)
                    const bandH = (ib.h >= 44 && ib.w >= 60) ? STAGE_BAND_H : 0
                    if (bandH > 0) out["stgband:" + i.key] = rounded({ x: ib.x, y: ib.y, w: ib.w, h: bandH })
                    const boxes: Record<string, Rect> = {}
                    bisect(boxes, i.syms, i.rows.map(s => capNow[s.sym]),
                        ib.x, ib.y + bandH, ib.w, Math.max(2, ib.h - bandH))
                    for (const sym of i.syms) {
                        const r = boxes[sym]
                        out["stage:" + sym] = rounded({ x: r.x, y: r.y,
                            w: Math.max(0, r.w - TILE_GAP), h: Math.max(0, r.h - TILE_GAP) })
                    }
                }
            }
        } else for (const t of tree) for (const i of t.inds) if (i.key == key) {
            const boxes: Record<string, Rect> = {}
            bisect(boxes, i.syms, i.rows.map(s => s.shares * interpClose(s.closes, day)),
                z.x + 3, z.y + STAGE_HEAD_H + 1, Math.max(8, z.w - 6), inner(0))
            for (const sym of i.syms) {
                const r = boxes[sym]
                out["stage:" + sym] = rounded({ x: r.x, y: r.y,
                    w: Math.max(0, r.w - TILE_GAP), h: Math.max(0, r.h - TILE_GAP) })
            }
        }
        return out
    }

    let stageMemoKey = ""
    let stageMemoVal: Record<string, Rect> = {}
    function stagePartition(stocks: Stock[], tree: SecNode[], day: number,
        W: number, H: number, stageKey: string, zoom: number,
        prevKey: string, progress: number): Record<string, Rect> {
        if (!stocks || !tree || stageKey == "" || zoom <= 0.0005 || !W || !H) return {}
        const memoKey = day.toFixed(4) + "|" + W + "|" + H + "|" + stageKey + "|" + zoom.toFixed(3)
            + "|" + prevKey + "|" + progress.toFixed(3)
        if (memoKey == stageMemoKey) return stageMemoVal
        const base = mapPartition(stocks, tree, day, W, H)
        const zoneAtRest = stageKey.slice(0, 4) == "sec:"
            ? base["sector:" + stageKey.slice(4)] : base["zone:" + stageKey]
        if (!zoneAtRest) return {}
        const out: Record<string, Rect> = {}
        const inset = Math.min(48, W * 0.05)
        const court = { x: inset, y: inset * 0.6, w: W - 2 * inset, h: H - inset * 1.2 }
        const zone = lerpRect(zoneAtRest, court, zoom)
        out["zone:" + stageKey] = rounded(zone)
        const cur = stageEntries(tree, day, stageKey, zone)
        if (progress >= 0.999 || prevKey == "" || prevKey == stageKey) {
            for (const k of Object.keys(cur)) out[k] = cur[k]
        } else {
            const prev = stageEntries(tree, day, prevKey, zone)
            const keys = [] as string[]
            for (const k of Object.keys(prev)) keys.push(k)
            for (const k of Object.keys(cur)) if (!keys.includes(k)) keys.push(k)
            for (const k of keys) {
                const a = prev[k] ?? shrunk(cur[k])
                const b = cur[k] ?? shrunk(prev[k])
                out[k] = rounded(lerpRect(a, b, progress))
            }
        }
        stageMemoKey = memoKey
        stageMemoVal = out
        return out
    }

    // ── color and text ──

    // finviz's palette: neutral slate, saturating to green/red at ±3%
    function changeColor(ret: number): number {
        const t = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, ret / 0.03))
        const mix = (a: number, b: number, k: number) => Math.round(a + (b - a) * k)
        let r = 65, g = 69, b = 84
        if (t > 0) { r = mix(r, 48, t); g = mix(g, 204, t); b = mix(b, 90, t) }
        else { r = mix(r, 246, -t); g = mix(g, 53, -t); b = mix(b, 56, -t) }
        return r * 65536 + g * 256 + b
    }

    function fmtPct(ret: number): string {
        return (ret >= 0 ? "+" : "") + (ret * 100).toFixed(1) + "%"
    }

    function fmtCap(cap: number): string {
        return cap >= 1e12 ? "$" + (cap / 1e12).toFixed(2) + "T" : "$" + (cap / 1e9).toFixed(0) + "B"
    }

    function fmtPrice(p: number): string {
        return "$" + (p >= 1000 ? p.toFixed(0) : p.toFixed(2))
    }

    function fmtDateLong(iso: string): string {
        if (!iso) return ""
        const d = new Date(iso + "T12:00:00Z")
        const wd = ["SUN", "MON", "TUE", "WED", "THU", "FRI", "SAT"][d.getUTCDay()]
        const mo = ["JAN", "FEB", "MAR", "APR", "MAY", "JUN", "JUL", "AUG", "SEP", "OCT", "NOV", "DEC"][d.getUTCMonth()]
        return wd + " " + d.getUTCDate() + " " + mo + " " + d.getUTCFullYear()
    }

    function fmtDateShort(iso: string): string {
        if (!iso) return ""
        const d = new Date(iso + "T12:00:00Z")
        const mo = ["JAN", "FEB", "MAR", "APR", "MAY", "JUN", "JUL", "AUG", "SEP", "OCT", "NOV", "DEC"][d.getUTCMonth()]
        return d.getUTCDate() + " " + mo + " '" + String(d.getUTCFullYear()).slice(2)
    }

    function fmtMonthYear(iso: string): string {
        if (!iso) return ""
        const d = new Date(iso + "T12:00:00Z")
        const mo = ["JAN", "FEB", "MAR", "APR", "MAY", "JUN", "JUL", "AUG", "SEP", "OCT", "NOV", "DEC"][d.getUTCMonth()]
        return mo + " " + d.getUTCFullYear()
    }

    function stageTitle(key: string): string {
        if (key.slice(0, 4) == "sec:") return key.slice(4) + "  ·  ALL INDUSTRIES"
        const parts = key.split("|")
        return parts.length > 1 ? parts[1] + "  ·  " + parts[0] : key
    }
    }

segments.md:
## The palette

Every color the app paints, named by role: Finviz's dark console, its yellow
highlight, and the inks that sit on each. The day's change on a tile is not
here — that is a scale over the data (`changeColor`), not a token. The App
provides this record over the house tokens, so the library's Slider still
finds everything it reads.

segments.md:
## The App

Assembly, top to bottom: the console (slider, era chips, live date), the map
field (tiles and bands under `MarketLayout`, with the halo, scrim, and stage
as self-positioned chrome), and the legend. All interaction state is a handful
of app attributes; every appearance below derives from them.

segments.html:
App [ theme = { { ...SanFrancisco, ...MarketMap } }, fill = { provided("theme").page }, appName = "Market Map",
    fontFamily = ["Helvetica Neue", "Helvetica", "Arial", "sans-serif"],

    // when the data lands, open on its last day outright — writing both the
    // sprung slot and its target parks the flight spring on the present day, whatever
    // span the file carries

    market: Market [
        landed(nDays: number) {
            app.day = nDays - 1
            app.targetDay = nDays - 1
            }
        ],

    // ── time: one sprung scalar. The slider retargets it stiffly, a chip
    // softly — same spring, different constants, so a chip click flies the
    // map through every intervening day and stays interruptible.
    // The defaults only cover the beat before the data arrives; the market's
    // `landed` hook (below) then opens the app on the data's last day.

    day: number = { app.nDays - 1 },
    targetDay: number = { app.nDays - 1 },
    gliding: boolean = false,
    flight: Spring [ attribute = day, to = { app.targetDay },
        stiffness = { app.gliding ? 5 : 230 }, damping = { app.gliding ? 4.4 : 26 } ],

    scrub(v: number) { this.gliding = false
        this.targetDay = v },
    flyTo(iso: string) { this.gliding = true
        this.targetDay = this.market.dayIndexOf(iso) },

    // ── the stage: which group is zoomed, how far, and the drill morph.
    // `prevStageKey` is kept through a close so the collapse still has
    // geometry to return to. The drill is a flip-flop: each drill toggles
    // `drillFlip`, the spring chases it, and progress reads 0→1 either way.

    stageKey: string = "",
    prevStageKey: string = "",
    stageOpen: boolean = false,
    zoom: number = 0,
    zoomer: Spring [ attribute = zoom, to = { app.stageOpen ? 1 : 0 }, stiffness = 240, damping = 26 ],
    drillFlip: boolean = false,
    drillT: number = 0,
    driller: Spring [ attribute = drillT, to = { app.drillFlip ? 1 : 0 }, stiffness = 240, damping = 26 ],
    drillProgress: number = { this.drillFlip ? this.drillT : 1 - this.drillT },

    openGroup(k: string) { if (this.stageOpen) return
        this.prevStageKey = ""
        this.stageKey = k
        this.stageOpen = true },
    drill(k: string) { if (!this.stageOpen || k == this.stageKey) return
        this.prevStageKey = this.stageKey
        this.stageKey = k
        this.hotStaged = ""
        this.drillFlip = !this.drillFlip },
    closeGroup() { this.stageOpen = false
        this.hotStaged = "" },

    // Escape dismisses the stage, same as its close box. A Keys member —
    // lifetime-managed, no listener to clean up.

    keys: Keys [
        onKeyUp(e: KeyEvent) { if (e.key == "Escape" && app.stageOpen) app.closeGroup() }
        ],

    // the records the stage needs right now — stage structure follows this,
    // never a timer (see the Market note on rosterFor)

    stageRoster: Dataset [ contents = { app.market.rosterFor(app.stageKey, app.prevStageKey) } ],

    // ── hover state: one key for the map's hot group, one for the stage's
    // hot sub-industry. Highlights gate on the derived hover facts, so
    // leaving the grid or the popup drops them with no pointer-out handling.

    hotGroup: string = "",
    hotStaged: string = "",
    fieldHover: boolean = { this.field.hovered },
    stageHover: boolean = { this.field.stage.hovered || this.field.stagebox.hovered },

    spotLine: string = "",
    spot(sym: string) {
        const s = (this.market.stocks as Stock[]).find(k => k.sym == sym)
        if (!s) return
        this.spotLine = s.name.toUpperCase() + " · " + s.industry + " · "
            + fmtCap(this.market.capAt(s.shares, s.closes, this.day)) + " · "
            + fmtPct(this.market.dayChangeAt(s.closes, this.day))
        },

    // ── derived geometry ──

    nDays: number = { app.market.nDays || 1 },
    narrow: boolean = { this.width < 720 },
    legendH: number = { this.narrow ? 58 : 34 },
    mapY: number = { this.top.height + 16 },
    mapW: number = { this.width },
    mapH: number = { this.height - this.mapY - this.legendH },

    // ── the console ──

    top: View [ width = 100%, fill = { provided("theme").panel },

        // the console has an inside: every control is written against it, and
        // the panel is as tall as what it holds plus the inset under it

        padding = [0, 24, 20, 24],

        // the span reads off the data itself, so a different file retitles the app

        title: Text [ y = 12, fontSize = 10, letterSpacing = 3, fontWeight = bold,
            textColor = { provided("theme").inkMuted }, visible = { !app.narrow },
            text = { "MARKET MAP — S&P 500" + (app.market.ready
                ? ", " + fmtMonthYear(app.market.dateAt(0)) + " → " + fmtMonthYear(app.market.dateAt(app.nDays - 1))
                : "") } ],
        date: Text [ x = end, y = 10,
            fontSize = { app.narrow ? 13 : 17 }, fontWeight = bold,
            letterSpacing = 1, textColor = { provided("theme").ink },
            text = { fmtDateLong(app.market.dateAt(app.day)) } ],

        // min = 1: day zero has no prior close, so no day-over-day color

        scrubber: Slider [ y = 40, width = 100%,
            min = 1, max = { app.nDays - 1 },
            value = { app.day },
            input(v: number) { app.scrub(v) }
            ],

        chips: View [ y = 72, width = 100%,
            layout: WrappingLayout [ spacing = 8, rowSpacing = 8 ],

            // editorial, anchored to this file's span — the crash/bottom dates
            // are the data's own drawdown troughs; revisit on a data swap

            EraChip [ label = "START '19", iso = "2019-11-15" ],
            EraChip [ label = "COVID CRASH", iso = "2020-03-23" ],
            EraChip [ label = "PEAK '22", iso = "2022-01-03" ],
            EraChip [ label = "BEAR BOTTOM '22", iso = "2022-10-14" ],
            EraChip [ label = "AI ERA", iso = "2023-05-25" ],
            EraChip [ label = "APR '25 SHOCK", iso = "2025-04-08" ],
            EraChip [ label = "LAST DAY", iso = "2099-01-01" ]
            ]
        ],

    // ── the map field ──

    field: View [ y = { app.mapY }, width = 100%, height = { app.mapH }, clip = true,
        layout: MarketLayout [ ],
        datapath = { app.market.table.value },

        Tile [ datapath = :stocks[] ],
        IndustryBand [ datapath = :industries[] ],
        SectorBand [ datapath = :sectors[] ],

        // self-positioned chrome opts out of the layout

        scrim: View [ ignoreLayout = true, width = 100%, height = 100%, fill = { provided("theme").scrim },
            pointerEvents = "none",
            opacity = { app.zoom * 0.62 },
            visible = { app.zoom > 0.01 } ],

        // the finviz-yellow halo around whichever group is hot

        halo: View [ ignoreLayout = true, pointerEvents = "none", fill = null,
            r: object = { rectFor(mapPartition(app.market.stocks as Stock[], app.market.tree as SecNode[], app.day, app.mapW, app.mapH) as Record<string, Rect>,
                app.hotGroup.slice(0, 4) == "sec:" ? "sector:" + app.hotGroup.slice(4) : "zone:" + app.hotGroup) },
            visible = { app.hotGroup != "" && app.fieldHover
                && app.zoom < 0.05 && (this.r as Rect).x > -800 },
            x = { (this.r as Rect).x - 1 },
            y = { (this.r as Rect).y - 1 },
            width = { (this.r as Rect).w + 2 },
            height = { (this.r as Rect).h + 2 },
            stroke = { stroke(2, provided("theme").highlight) }
            ],

        // the stage: backdrop + yellow title bar; its roster paints above

        stage: View [ ignoreLayout = true, fill = { provided("theme").stage },
            r: object = { rectFor(stagePartition(app.market.stocks as Stock[], app.market.tree as SecNode[], app.day, app.mapW, app.mapH, app.stageKey, app.zoom, app.prevStageKey, app.drillProgress) as Record<string, Rect>, "zone:" + app.stageKey) },
            visible = { app.zoom > 0.002 && app.stageKey != "" },
            x = { (this.r as Rect).x },
            y = { (this.r as Rect).y },
            width = { (this.r as Rect).w },
            height = { (this.r as Rect).h },
            stroke = { stroke(2, provided("theme").highlight) },

            head: View [ width = 100%, height = { STAGE_HEAD_H }, fill = { provided("theme").highlight }, clip = true,
                onPointerOver() { app.hotStaged = "" },       // the bar is not a subitem
                Text [ x = 10, y = center, fontSize = 11, letterSpacing = 2, fontWeight = bold,
                    textColor = { provided("theme").inkOnHighlight }, opacity = { app.zoom },
                    text = { stageTitle(app.stageKey) } ],
                Text [ x = { parent.width - this.width - 36 }, y = center, fontSize = 10,
                    letterSpacing = 1, textColor = { provided("theme").inkOnHighlight }, opacity = { app.zoom * 0.75 },
                    text = { app.zoom > 0.3 ? app.market.groupStat(app.stageKey, app.day) : "" } ]
                ],
            closeBox: View [ x = { parent.width - 26 }, y = 4, width = 22, height = 22,
                cornerRadius = 4, cursor = "pointer",
                fill = { hovered ? provided("theme").highlightHover : provided("theme").highlight },
                opacity = { app.zoom },
                onClick() { app.closeGroup() },
                CloseIcon [ x = center, y = center, iconSize = 14, ink = { provided("theme").inkOnHighlight } ]
                ]
            ],

        // the staged roster — bands, tiles, and the sub-group halo

        stagebox: View [ ignoreLayout = true, width = 100%, height = 100%,
            datapath = { app.stageRoster.value },
            layout: StageLayout [ ],
            StageBand [ datapath = :bands[] ],
            StageTile [ datapath = :rows[] ],
            stghalo: View [ ignoreLayout = true, pointerEvents = "none", fill = null,
                r: object = { rectFor(stagePartition(app.market.stocks as Stock[], app.market.tree as SecNode[], app.day, app.mapW, app.mapH, app.stageKey, app.zoom, app.prevStageKey, app.drillProgress) as Record<string, Rect>, "stgzone:" + app.hotStaged) },
                visible = { app.stageKey.slice(0, 4) == "sec:" && app.hotStaged != ""
                    && app.stageHover && app.zoom > 0.5 && (this.r as Rect).x > -800 },
                x = { (this.r as Rect).x - 1 },
                y = { (this.r as Rect).y - 1 },
                width = { (this.r as Rect).w + 2 },
                height = { (this.r as Rect).h + 2 },
                stroke = { stroke(2, provided("theme").highlight) }
                ]
            ]
        ],

    // ── the legend ──

    legend: View [ y = { parent.height - app.legendH }, width = 100%, height = { app.legendH },
        fill = { provided("theme").panel }, clip = true,
        readout: Text [ x = 24, y = 8, fontSize = 11, textColor = { provided("theme").inkSoft },
            opacity = 0.85, width = { parent.width - 48 },
            text = { app.spotLine } ],
        gamut: View [ height = 18,
            x = { app.narrow ? (parent.width - this.width) / 2 : parent.width - this.width - 24 },
            y = { app.narrow ? 32 : 8 },
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 4 ],
            LegendSwatch [ pct = -3 ],
            LegendSwatch [ pct = -2 ],
            LegendSwatch [ pct = -1 ],
            LegendSwatch [ pct = 0 ],
            LegendSwatch [ pct = 1 ],
            LegendSwatch [ pct = 2 ],
            LegendSwatch [ pct = 3 ]
            ]
        ]
